notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_7.md CB7-S, section 2.8 and section 9 (challenger round 1). DRAFT: copy to queue/jobs/ only after the science-reviewer freeze check of the fetcher, the committed rules file and a q0140 PASS. About 9k frame requests (closed and ended-unclosed walks) + 18k print requests (1 per sampled market: /trades?market&start=t7-7d&end=t7-1&takerOnly=true&limit=50) = about 27k requests, about 1.9 h at 4 rps, about 2.4 h wall in 2 chunks of 85 min. No CLOB history. Stage order: hash and pin checks, frame walk (streamed, resumable by window), filters (Yes/No labels, life >= 9 d, not weather/TEMP_RE, not CB1_UPDOWN_RE, not geopolitics by fee_category or topic_of, not Other/placeholder), key drop, stratified sample (status x cb1_topic x end month; sports weight 0.25; no price, volume or outcome input), M1-M7 and the clarification flag computed on the FULL description in memory (stored copy truncated to 4,000 chars; full length and sha256 stored), text_features.csv.gz and cut_points.json written and hashed BEFORE any print request, then prints. closed_time kept as a status field only. Outcome prices only in outcomes_guarded.csv.gz. No wallet field is stored. Rows capped at min(T_fetchT, T_seal); no chunk starts at or after T_seal (NOT_RUN_DEADLINE.json, status not_run_deadline). Exit 75 when data-dumps + 0.15 GB > 12.5 GB. Priority 61 with a higher id than q0043/q0081/q0082/q0120, so those T_seal-bound jobs win the net lane at every chunk boundary. NO Mac fallback (round 1, item 6): a run not complete before T_seal is recorded not_run_deadline and S1 is 'not run (deadline)', counted. Latest useful host start 2026-10-21T12:00Z. Commit message must record the data-dumps size and margin. IMPLEMENTATION 2026-10-17 (fetch side): argv matches scripts/run_cb7.py as built (declared arguments are checked; a changed one exits 2). Lane net. Each repeat chunk runs --budget-min 85 (timeout 5400 s); max_runs 8 leaves room for the frame-walk chunks, the item retry chunks (3 attempts per market) and a collector-health pause. Terminal statuses (exit 0): text_fetch_complete, not_run_deadline (NOT_RUN_DEADLINE.json), disjointness_unverified (DISJOINTNESS_UNVERIFIED.json, no sample, no prints). A full output cap (0.15 GB) is the declared end state disk_budget: exit 4 (NOT 75), sticky, never loops. Exit 75 only for data-dumps headroom (--data-dumps-cap-gb 12.5). Failed print requests are counted separately (print_request_failed) from markets with no print. The queue worker retries an exit-4 job up to max_retries; each retry returns the sticky disk_budget state without work. The commit message must record the section 2.8 headroom check. SMOKE V2 AMENDMENT 2026-10-17: pins seals/cb7_text_geo_rules_v2.json (rules_sha256 05bf365c...) and requires the smoke v2 PASS (creative_batch7/smoke_v2.json, smoke_version cb7-smoke-v2) under that hash; depends on q0140b. The v1 smoke.json (FAIL) is never consulted.
